title: Annual General Meeting
timeline: Within 6 months of FY end; max 15 months between AGMs
filing_mode: Meeting – notice, minutes and SS-2 compliance (no MCA form)
note: OPCs are exempt. Record the actual AGM date in the AGM field to unlock AGM-linked deadlines.

title: AOC-4 – financial statements (XBRL for listed and specified larger companies)
timeline: Within 30 days of AGM
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)

title: AOC-1 – subsidiaries / associates / JVs, with consolidated financial statements
timeline: Along with AOC-4
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC) (attachment to AOC-4)

title: MGT-7A – abridged annual return (small companies)
timeline: Within 60 days of AGM
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)
note: Small company: paid-up capital up to ₹10 cr and turnover up to ₹100 cr (from 1 Dec 2025); not a holding/subsidiary/Section 8/special-Act company.

title: MGT-7 – annual return
timeline: Within 60 days of AGM
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)

title: MGT-8 – PCS certificate on annual return
timeline: With MGT-7
filing_mode: MCA e-form attachment; certificate from practising Company Secretary
note: Always for listed companies; for others if paid-up capital ≥ ₹10 cr or turnover ≥ ₹50 cr. Confirm the current MCA clarification on overlap with MGT-7A.

title: ADT-1 – appointment / re-appointment of auditor
timeline: Within 15 days of the AGM appointment
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)
note: Needed only in a year when an auditor is appointed or re-appointed. Mark Not applicable otherwise.

title: DPT-3 – return of deposits / exempted receipts
timeline: By 30 June annually
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)

title: MSME-1 – dues to MSME suppliers beyond 45 days (April–September)
timeline: By 31 October
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)

title: MSME-1 – dues to MSME suppliers beyond 45 days (October–March)
timeline: By 30 April
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)

title: DIR-3 KYC Web – director KYC
regulation: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Amendment Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 943(E))
timeline: Once every 3 financial years by 30 June; next due 30 June 2028 for directors who completed KYC up to FY 2025-26; changes in details within 30 days
filing_mode: MCA portal – single Form DIR-3 KYC Web
note: Replaces the old annual 30 September deadline.

title: PAS-6 – reconciliation of share capital audit
regulation: Rule 9A, Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Rules
timeline: Within 60 days of each half-year end
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)
note: Listed companies report through LODR / depository filings instead.

title: MR-3 – secretarial audit report
regulation: Section 204; Companies (Appointment and Remuneration of Managerial Personnel) Rules
timeline: Annexed to the Board's report sent with the AGM notice
filing_mode: MCA portal Annexure to Board's report (Form MR-3)
note: Mandatory for listed companies and larger public companies; confirm current Rule 9 text.

title: CSR-2 – CSR reporting
timeline: Along with AOC-4
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)
note: CSR applies at net worth ≥ ₹500 cr, turnover ≥ ₹1,000 cr or net profit ≥ ₹5 cr in the prior year.

title: DIR-12 – appointment / cessation / change of directors and KMP
regulation: Section 170; Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules
timeline: Within 30 days of the event
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)

title: MGT-14 – filing of resolutions and agreements
timeline: Within 30 days of passing the resolution
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)
note: Special resolutions for private companies; board resolutions under s.179(3) and others for public companies.

title: PAS-3 – return of allotment
timeline: Within 30 days of allotment
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)

title: BEN-2 – significant beneficial owner declaration
timeline: Within 30 days of the declaration
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)
note: Conditional: only when an SBO declaration is received.

title: CHG-1 – creation or modification of charge
timeline: Within 30 days of creation
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)
note: Conditional: only when a charge is created or modified.

title: MR-1 – appointment of MD / WTD / manager
timeline: Within 60 days of appointment
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)

title: CRA-2 – intimation of cost auditor appointment
regulation: Section 148; Cost Records and Audit Rules
timeline: Within 30 days of Board approval
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)
note: Confirm sector and turnover limits in the Cost Records Rules.

title: CRA-4 – cost audit report
regulation: Section 148; Cost Records and Audit Rules
timeline: Within 30 days of receipt of the cost audit report
filing_mode: MCA portal e-form (with DSC)
note: Confirm sector and turnover limits in the Cost Records Rules.

title: IEPF – transfer of unpaid dividend and shares
timeline: As prescribed under IEPF Rules after the 7-year period
filing_mode: IEPF portal / MCA
note: Enter the transfer due date as the event date.

title: Board meetings – minimum 4 per year, gap not above 120 days
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form
note: Small companies, OPCs and dormant companies need one meeting per half-year.

title: Independent directors (1/3 of board for listed; 2 for larger unlisted public)
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Woman director
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form
note: Listed public; public companies with paid-up capital ≥ ₹100 cr or turnover ≥ ₹300 cr.

title: Audit committee and Nomination & Remuneration committee
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Stakeholders Relationship Committee
timeline: Continuous – where more than 1,000 holders
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Key managerial personnel (MD/CEO, CS, CFO)
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Internal audit
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Auditor rotation
timeline: Confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: CSR committee, CSR policy and spend
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Cost records and cost audit
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Related party transactions and AOC-2
timeline: Confirm approvals and disclosure in Board's report
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Secretarial Standards SS-1 and SS-2
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Integrated Filing (Governance) report – investor grievances and corporate governance
timeline: One consolidated report within 30 days of quarter-end (earlier 21 days)
filing_mode: Integrated Filing (Governance) – XBRL on NSE NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre
note: Filed as a single Integrated Filing (Governance) report. SME-listed entities are exempt from Reg 27(2)(a), so only the investor grievance part applies to them. IGP-specific relaxations were not verified in the matrix.

title: Integrated Filing (Governance) report – corporate governance (HVDLE)
timeline: One consolidated report within 30 days of quarter-end
filing_mode: Integrated Filing (Governance) – XBRL on NSE NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre

title: Shareholding pattern
timeline: Within 21 days of quarter-end
filing_mode: Exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre) – XBRL
note: Confirm routing for your exchange.

title: Integrated Filing (Financial) – quarterly / annual financial results
timeline: Within 45 days of Q1–Q3 end; 60 days of FY end for Q4 / annual
filing_mode: Integrated Filing (Financial) – XBRL on NSE NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre
note: Limited review / audit report to accompany.

title: Half-yearly financial results (SME may opt for half-yearly)
timeline: Within 45 days of half-year end; 60 days for the year-end half
filing_mode: Integrated Filing (Financial) – XBRL on NSE NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre
note: SME entities may opt for half-yearly results; use quarterly rows if you report quarterly.

title: Related party transactions disclosure
timeline: Filed with results under current exchange formats
filing_mode: Integrated Filing (Financial) – XBRL on NSE NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre
note: Reg 23 applies to SME entities from 1 April 2025; a few filings still claim otherwise, so check your exchange's current circular.

title: Statement of deviation / variation in use of issue proceeds (with monitoring agency report where required)
timeline: Quarterly, along with results
filing_mode: Integrated Filing (Financial) – XBRL on NSE NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre

title: Reconciliation of share capital audit report
timeline: Within 30 days of quarter-end
filing_mode: Exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre) – XBRL
note: Not a LODR regulation, but filed through the same exchange process.

title: Annual secretarial compliance report (PCS)
timeline: Within 60 days of financial year-end
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: SME entities are exempt (Reg 15(2)(b)).

title: Annual report
timeline: At least 21 clear days before the AGM
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)

title: Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR)
timeline: With the annual report
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: BRSR applies to the top 1000 listed entities.

title: BRSR Core – reasonable assurance (top 500)
timeline: With the annual report, from FY 2025-26
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Glide path: top 500 from FY 2025-26.

title: BRSR Core – reasonable assurance (top 1000)
timeline: With the annual report, from FY 2026-27
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Glide path: top 1000 from FY 2026-27.

title: Voting results of the AGM / general meeting
timeline: Within 2 working days of the meeting
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)

title: AGM within 5 months of year-end (top 100)
timeline: By 31 August
filing_mode: Meeting – notice, minutes and SS-2 compliance (no MCA form)
note: Top 100 listed entities only.

title: Live webcast of AGM (top 100)
timeline: On the date of the AGM
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Verification of market rumours
timeline: As specified in the Regulation after a rumour is reported
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Top 100 from 1 June 2024; top 250 from 1 December 2024.

title: At least one independent woman director (top 1000)

filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: D&O insurance for independent directors (top 1000)

filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Dividend distribution policy (top 1000)
timeline: Policy disclosed in annual report and on website
filing_mode: Company website; exchange intimation where specified

title: Board of at least six directors (top 2000)
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Non-executive chairperson not related to MD/CEO (top 500)
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form
note: Whether this is currently mandatory was not verified in the matrix. Check before relying on it.

title: Corporate governance: board composition, committees, independent directors, subsidiaries
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form
note: Exempt where paid-up equity ≤ ₹10 cr and net worth ≤ ₹25 cr (Reg 15(2)); once crossed, coverage continues until below thresholds for three consecutive years.

title: Related party transaction approvals (audit committee / shareholders)
timeline: Before each material transaction
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Website disclosures
timeline: Continuous – keep website current
filing_mode: Company website; exchange intimation where specified
note: For SME entities only Reg 46 provisions not exempted under Reg 15(2)(b) apply.

title: Prior intimation of Board meeting
timeline: Typically 2 to 5 working days before the meeting, depending on the agenda
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Enter the Board meeting date as the event date. Check the clause for your agenda.

title: Outcome of Board meeting
timeline: Within 30 minutes of closure of the meeting
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)

title: Other material events / information
timeline: Within 12 to 24 hours of the event, as applicable
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)

title: Record date / corporate-action intimation
timeline: Before the record date, per the Regulation
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Enter the last date for intimation as the event date.

title: Prior intimation of Board meeting (debt)
timeline: Before the Board meeting, per the Regulation
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Enter the Board meeting date as the event date.

title: Material events and information (debt)
timeline: Within the time specified in Schedule III
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)

title: Half-yearly financial results (debt)

filing_mode: Integrated Filing (Financial) – XBRL on NSE NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre

title: Asset cover and covenant compliance (debt)
timeline: Along with financial results
filing_mode: Integrated Filing (Financial) – XBRL on NSE NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre

title: Utilisation of issue proceeds (debt)
timeline: Along with financial results
filing_mode: Integrated Filing (Financial) – XBRL on NSE NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre

title: Credit rating – assignment, revision or withdrawal (debt)
timeline: Within the time specified in the Regulation
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)

title: Intimation of interest / redemption payment (debt)
timeline: Before the payment date, per the Regulation
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Enter the payment date as the event date.

title: Communications to debenture trustee
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Website disclosures (debt)
timeline: Continuous – keep website current
filing_mode: Company website; exchange intimation where specified

title: HVDLE governance provisions (board composition, committees, related-party norms)
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form
note: HVDLE threshold is ₹5,000 crore of listed NCDs (earlier ₹1,000 crore). Confirm Gazette text.

title: Code of Fair Disclosure – board-approved, hosted on website
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Company website; exchange intimation where specified

title: Code of Conduct – trading window, pre-clearance, designated persons, 6-month contra-trade restriction
timeline: Continuous – confirm for the financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Trading window closure and depository PAN-freeze confirmation
timeline: Window closed from quarter-end until 48 hours after results; confirm designated persons and closure dates on the depository portal at least 2 trading days ahead
filing_mode: Internal closure notice; depository portal confirmation
note: Due date shown is the last date to confirm closure dates on the depository portal (2 trading days before closure). PAN freeze is being phased in for all listed companies.

title: Structured Digital Database – maintenance (kept at least 8 years)
timeline: Continuous – tamper-proof software with audit trail
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Structured Digital Database – entry for UPSI shared externally
timeline: Within 2 days of sharing UPSI externally (2025 amendment)
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Continual disclosure – company informs exchange of insider trades above ₹10 lakh
timeline: Insider to company within 2 trading days; company to exchange within 2 trading days thereafter
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Aggregate trades above ₹10 lakh in a calendar quarter. Enter the date of receipt from the insider as the event date.

title: Initial disclosures on listing / appointment of promoters, KMPs, directors, designated persons
timeline: Within 30 days of listing or 7 days of appointment
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Enter the date of appointment as the event date.

title: Board / audit committee review of PIT internal controls, whistle-blower mechanism and compliance
timeline: At least once each financial year
filing_mode: Internal record / board process – no external form

title: Reporting of PIT violations to the exchanges
timeline: As per SEBI's format
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)
note: Enter the target filing date as the event date.

title: Acquirer disclosure – acquisition of 5% or more
timeline: Within 2 working days to target and exchanges
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)

title: Acquirer disclosure – change of 2% or more (holding already 5%+)
timeline: Within 2 working days
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)

title: Annual disclosure by persons holding 25% or more
timeline: Within 7 working days after 31 March
filing_mode: To target company and exchanges via exchange portal

title: Annual disclosure by promoters and PACs
timeline: Within 7 working days after 31 March
filing_mode: To target company and exchanges via exchange portal

title: Encumbrance – creation, invocation or release
timeline: Within 7 working days
filing_mode: To target company and exchanges via exchange portal

title: Annual declaration of non-encumbrance
timeline: Within 7 working days after financial year-end
filing_mode: To target company and exchanges via exchange portal

title: Open offer – crossing 25%, creeping acquisition, change of control, indirect acquisition
timeline: Per the Regulations after the trigger
filing_mode: Merchant banker files with SEBI and exchanges
note: Enter the date by which the next step is due as the event date.

title: Exemptions – inter-se transfers etc.
timeline: Prior notice to exchanges within the specified time
filing_mode: Online submission on exchange portal (NEAPS / BSE Listing Centre)

title: FC-GPR – issue of equity instruments to a non-resident

timeline: Within 30 days of allotment
filing_mode: RBI FIRMS (Single Master Form) through AD bank; bulk upload available

title: FC-TRS – transfer of shares between resident and non-resident
timeline: Within 60 days of transfer or receipt of consideration
filing_mode: RBI FIRMS (Single Master Form) through AD bank
note: Not needed for on-market trades by FPIs / NRIs (handled by depositories and brokers).

title: Form DI – downstream investment
timeline: Within 30 days of allotment
filing_mode: RBI FIRMS (Single Master Form) through AD bank

title: FLA – Foreign Liabilities and Assets return
timeline: 15 July annually (plan for 15 July even if RBI extends)
filing_mode: RBI FLAIR portal

title: Form FC – overseas direct / portfolio investment
timeline: Per OI Directions at investment or event
filing_mode: AD bank / FIRMS

title: APR – Annual Performance Report for each overseas entity
timeline: By 31 December annually (following year if foreign year-end is 31 December)
filing_mode: Through AD bank
note: Based on audited foreign accounts.

title: ECB – LRN before drawdown; ECB-2 monthly returns
timeline: LRN before drawdown; monthly returns (confirm current day count)
filing_mode: AD bank
